name: genpark-personal-agent-sleep-apnea-desaturation-screener-skill
title: Nocturnal SpO2 Oxygen Desaturation & ODI Sleep Apnea Screener Skill
description: Oxygen Desaturation Index (ODI3/ODI4), SpO2 dip nadir and duration, pulse rate variability nocturnal arousal proxy, and sleep quality index. Built for GenPark (https://www.genpark.ai).

tools.name: calculate_oxygen_desaturation_index
tools.description: Compute ODI3 (events/hr with >= 3% SpO2 drop) and lowest nocturnal nadir from pulse oximetry time series.

tools.name: classify_nocturnal_hypoxemia_severity
tools.description: Classify sleep apnea risk tier (Mild, Moderate, Severe) and recommend clinical polysomnography urgency.
